Amazon-10605481.title: Sr. Account Manager, Private Brand
Amazon-10605481.description:
Amazon provides enterprises the opportunity to sell their goods on the Amazon platform worldwide, and more than 2 million sellers have been using this Marketplace service today. Amazon is developing infrastructure  to support this growth, particularly in the booming cross-border selling area.
Project DeLorean is a nascent but fast-expanding Basic Licensed program that recruits China-based Selling Partners (SPs) to design, source, and sell products under Amazon's owned brand licenses (e.g., Amazon Essentials) across Amazon's Global marketplaces. The program combines Amazon's brand equity and demand signals with the manufacturing and operational strengths of top CN sellers — unlocking a differentiated, high-selection, high-quality product pipeline for Amazon customers while opening a new growth avenue for Selling Partners.
In this context, the Project DeLorean team is seeking an experienced Account Manager who will work closely with licensed SPs to onboard them into the program, drive selection and business performance, and provide 1:1 consultancy to maximize the success of their DeLorean portfolio. You will own the end-to-end SP relationship — from Onboarding, Selection, to ongoing performance management — while delivering a first-class level of service for SP satisfaction.
The Account Manager will have experience building relationships with internal and external stakeholders, and the ability to deliver results. Become a thought leader in defining success criteria and understanding the business needs of licensed sellers operating under a brand-licensed model in an ever-changing environment. Manage all aspects of the client relationship for the highest standard of seller experience across the DeLorean onboarding-to-growth lifecycle.
Key job responsibilities
1. Seller recruitment & onboarding — Identify, recruit, and onboard high-potential CN SPs into the DeLorean program; guide them through licensing requirements, program mechanics, and the product-development workflow.
2. Selection strategy — Partner with selection/PM teams to drive selection decisions; use data and category insight to prioritize the right products for the right sellers and marketplaces.
3. Deep-dive performance diagnosis — Conduct deep-dive analysis on key factors affecting SP performance, diagnose root causes, and provide actionable plans spanning (a) operational improvements, (b) product development, and (c) process improvement.
4. Voice of Seller & growth planning — Identify key business opportunities through Voice of Seller and data analysis, and manage SPs toward a growth plan.
5. Program execution — Implement account management best practices and SOPs into the DeLorean business-development framework; support OP1 planning inputs and revenue-model tracking for your SP portfolio.
6. Cross-functional innovation — Collaborate with PM / Central teams to drive product, feature, service, and process innovations that further improve SP business and SP satisfaction, and feed category insight back to scale program growth.
About the team
The Account Manager (AM) provides value-added services with holistic account management support, including: 1) onboarding SPs into the DeLorean program and guiding them through licensing and the product-development workflow; 2) monitoring and maintaining performance, and working with sellers to improve it; 3) proactively identifying and addressing issues that may impact selection launch or revenue generation; and 4) working across all relevant cross-functional areas (PM, selection, Ops, legal/brand) to guarantee effective communication, implementation, and execution of objectives.

Amazon-3201456.title: Sr. Brand Marketing Manager, Amazon Ads CN Brand Marketing
Amazon-3201456.description:
Amazon Ads empowers brands to build globally. As a trusted partner for cross-border advertisers, we help brands connect with hundreds of millions of customers through rich, first-party insights — spanning shopping, streaming, and browsing behaviors — that enable more relevant, measurable, and impactful advertising experiences. Our growing portfolio spans sponsored ads on Amazon.com, streaming TV advertising across Prime Video and live sports, programmatic solutions through Amazon DSP, and an expanding partner network of third-party publishers and exchanges. From awareness to conversion, on and off Amazon, we help brands reach the right audiences in the right moments — and measure the results that matter. Amazon Ads is one of Amazon's fastest-growing businesses, and we are just getting started.
As our product portfolio, market presence, and ambition continue to scale, our brand must keep pace. Today, the market knows our products — but not yet our story. We need a senior brand strategist to change that.
We are seeking a Senior Brand Strategist to serve as the single-threaded owner of Amazon Ads' brand positioning and strategy. This is not a campaign execution role. This is the person who defines what Amazon Ads stands for — and makes the market believe it.
In this role, you will build the foundational brand framework from the ground up: positioning, narrative, architecture, and audience strategy. You will translate that framework into a cross-team implementation roadmap, aligning cross-functional teams around unified communications and a coherent brand story. You will be the connective tissue between brand vision and market-facing reality — ensuring that every touchpoint, from a product launch to an industry keynote, reflects who we are and why we matter.
We are looking for someone who truly understands brand strategy — the deep, structural work of defining market positioning, competitive differentiation, audience architecture, and long-term brand equity. If you've spent your career building brands that shape how markets think, we want to talk to you.
Key job responsibilities
· Own and develop Amazon Ads' brand positioning strategy end-to-end in China, including brand purpose, promise, pillars, personality, and positioning statement that serves as the strategic foundation for all downstream marketing and communications efforts.
· Clearly articulate Amazon Ads' brand positioning to the market — ensuring advertisers, agencies, industry analysts, and internal stakeholders understand who we are, what we stand for, and how we are differentiated in an increasingly crowded advertising landscape.
· Architect a cross-functional brand implementation strategy, translating the brand framework into actionable guidelines, toolkits, and playbooks for product marketing, sales enablement, creative, events, PR/communications, and regional marketing teams.
· Serve as the strategic brand advisor to senior leadership, global stakeholders and cross-functional partners, establishing governance mechanisms to protect brand integrity while enabling teams to execute with speed and creativity.
· Leverage brand research, competitive intelligence, and customer insights to continuously refine positioning and inform strategic decisions on brand direction.
· Establish KPIs and measurement frameworks to track brand health — including awareness, perception, consideration, and preference — and report on the impact of brand strategy on business growth.
· Work closely with Legal and PR teams to shape thought leadership narratives and executive messaging that reinforce the Amazon Ads brand in key industry moments.
· Partner with business teams on holistic advertiser communication plans related to new product GTM launches in China, ensuring alignment with the overarching brand narrative.
· Drive brand strategy reviews and planning cycles, presenting strategic recommendations to CN and global stakeholders with clarity and conviction.

Amazon-10541393.title: Sr. Devices Business Manager , Devices Business Management (DBM)
Amazon-10541393.description:
Amazon Lab126 is an inventive research and development company that designs and engineers high-profile consumer electronics. Lab126 began in 2004 as a subsidiary of Amazon.com, Inc., originally creating the best-selling Kindle family of products. Since then, we have produced amazing devices like Fire tablets, Fire TV and Amazon Echo. What will you help us create?
The Business Manager is the relationship owner for the Amazon Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS) Device Manufacturing Services  suppliers that provide co-development resources, procure components, design, manufacture and test digital devices in the Emerging Products space. In this capacity the Business Manager has the responsibility to:
- Lead the sourcing, selection, contract negotiation and management of one or more EMS suppliers in alignment with the overarching EMS strategy and within the Integrated Management System. Ensure a competitive sourcing environment leading to continuous improvement in Engr. Services, Line Readiness, Quality, Business Management, Contract management and adherence, delivery, cost and social responsibility.
- Actively engage the Device Operations and Engineering organizations with the EMS suppliers on one or more products/product lines to achieve the programmatic objectives.
- Lead the commercial and contractual aspects of the relationship and drive multifunctional teams relative to EMS Suppliers involvement.
- Leading the EMS supplier Performance Management and leading cross-functional business reviews.
This requires that the Business Manager be both an advocate for the supplier within Lab126 and be their harshest critic to ensure the best possible performance.  Upon success,  the Business Manager will instill a forward-thinking collaborative and mutually-beneficial long-term relationship with a holistic point of view, not just a product or single supplier perspective – a business owner. These high profile responsibilities require significant breadth and business acumen as the responsibilities are very diverse and impactful:
Technical - Solid understanding of the EMS supplier landscape and capabilities in addition to Digital Device technologies and manufacturing / testing methodologies. Drive EMS Supplier relationships to ensure Amazon content is integrated in a way that supports our brand.
Negotiation Skills – Lead all commercial discussions related to EMS relationships. Able to negotiate best in class contract pricing, terms and conditions on large contracts with suppliers who are exceptionally skilled at protecting thin margins. Exercise good judgement in knowing when and how best to address issues or drive change.
Contract Management – Ensure that the suppliers execute and adhere to the contracts and renegotiate whenever possible to realize benefits from bundling work with Strategic Suppliers. This is not limited to dollars but being able to protect Amazon’s bottom line in all aspects – IP, indemnity, confidentiality, etc. as these are all crucial to how Amazon is able to have successful launches (products that “wow” the customer). In the case of an EMS relationship ensure that the contracts protect Amazon’s brand and meet customer requirements.
Financial – Responsible for managing the business relationship including contracts, pricing, terms and conditions and claims. Must be an effective negotiator. The value of these supplier engagements can reach the billion-dollar level.
Relationship Builder – Have the ability to engage, influence and arbitrate both the supplier and the Lab126 stakeholder organizations at the operational and Sr. Executive levels. Build excellent business cases and have executive presence.
About the team
Devices Business Management (DBM) is responsible for the business relationship with the EMS Suppliers. The DBM team is structured by Business Managers, CapEx Business Managers, Advanced Sourcing, Strategy leads and Implementation lead based in in different geographies. The team collaborates cross functionally with Product Operations, Engineering, Quality, legal and Finance throughout product life cycle to innovate, design for cost and quality ensuring timely delivery

Amazon-10555743.title: Sr. Partner Development Manager, Global Ads Partner Development
Amazon-10555743.description:
Global Partner Development manages Amazon Ads' relationships with independent agency and technology partners worldwide. Partners are force multipliers for Amazon Ads, capable of scaling capability, reach, and advertiser outcomes in ways that Amazon cannot achieve through direct sales alone. GPD's job is to build the commercial and capability infrastructure that makes those partnerships productive at scale.
PDMs own the full partner relationship lifecycle: commercial framework, executive engagement, and strategic development, with one standard: partners grow because of Amazon, not despite it.
This is not an account management role. PDMs do not manage campaigns, resolve portal access issues, or own day-to-day execution. They own the long-horizon work that determines whether a partner deepens its commitment to Amazon Ads or finds a path around it. A PDM's most important output is a partner that cannot imagine its growth trajectory without Amazon Ads embedded in it.
Key job responsibilities
Executive Relationship Ownership
•	Own the C-suite or most senior relationship with a defined set of agency or technology partners, including CEO, CMO, CRO, and CPO. These relationships are not shared, delegated, or rebuilt quickly if lost.
•	Operate consistently at Director, VP, and C-suite level. Meetings produce commitments, not action items.
•	Navigate partner organizations at multiple layers simultaneously, including holding company leadership, trading desk principals, and field teams. Influence at one level without losing credibility at another.
•	Anticipate partner needs before they arrive. The bar is not responsiveness; it is foresight.
Joint Business Planning
•	Architect Joint Business Plans (JBPs) that identify and activate growth pathways for each partner in your book. JBPs put the best of Amazon's resources to work for the partner's business, across marketing, product, and commercial enablement.
•	Build JBPs with a two-to-three year horizon. Align partner investments to mutual growth priorities. Know how your partners' strategy is evolving before they tell you.
•	Use the JBP as the primary vehicle for grounding the commercial relationship. The PA carries JBP strategy forward into targets and incentives. The scorecard holds both parties accountable and feeds the next JBP refresh.
Partner Agreement Strategy
•	Lead the design, negotiation, and renewal of Partner Agreements (PAs) for every partner in your book. Own the commercial framework end to end, including structure, incentive design, and close.
•	Co-develop targets with partners based on a genuine understanding of their book of business, growth potential, and client demand. Targets should reflect real stretch and a shared plan to reach them.
•	Build PAs that reflect a genuine commercial bet. Both sides have skin in the game and a shared plan to grow.
•	Work the year after next. PA renewals should feel like a natural output of the relationship, not a once-a-year negotiation.
Strategic Intelligence and Positioning
•	Stay ahead of where each partner is going strategically, including their product roadmap, competitive pressures, organizational changes, and how Amazon Ads fits their long-term model.
•	Translate partner signals into a clear internal point of view on how Amazon should engage, invest, or course-correct.
•	Use pattern recognition across your book to surface systemic issues. A policy gap that affects one partner likely affects twenty.
Commercial Development
•	Identify incremental revenue opportunities within your partner book, with a focus on Amazon-native capability adoption rather than undifferentiated volume.
•	Drive adoption of Amazon-native capabilities across partner tech and media roadmaps, including AMC, programmatic video, and first-party data integrations, so that partner-driven revenue is built on Amazon’s unique advantages, not on price or undifferentiated scale.
•	Collaborate with product, GGS, and finance to structure incentives, resolve blockers, and close commercial gaps.
Operational Rigor and Delivery
•	Translate strategy into execution, ensuring commitments made in planning are delivered through structured follow-through, clear ownership, and measurable outcomes.
•	Build partner capability as a core part of the role. Partners deepen their Amazon expertise, unlock differentiation, and adopt the products that drive Quality Dollar growth through PDM-led enablement.
•	Serve as the voice of your partners internally. Bring partner feedback, product gaps, and market intelligence to the teams that can act on it.
•	Escalate execution work to the right operational channels rather than absorbing it personally. Every hour spent on account management is an hour not spent on the next PA or integration.

Amazon-10587147.title: Sr. Product Manager, Global Compliance, Amazon Compliance Safety Services
Amazon-10587147.description:
Amazon is looking for a Sr. Product Manager to lead compliance product strategy for sellers manufacturing and selling globally from China. You will own the seller compliance experience for the fastest-growing cross-border seller population on Amazon, working directly with Chinese manufacturers, testing labs, certification bodies, and logistics providers to make compliance frictionless for sellers expanding into US, EU, UK, Japan, and beyond.
You will define and execute the product roadmap for compliance capabilities that serve China-based sellers across multiple programs: product safety testing, restricted products documentation, cross-border trade requirements, and regulatory filings. You will work backwards from seller pain points to build experiences where sellers learn their requirements once, test once, and launch globally from day one. This role is based in Shenzhen to be co-located with the seller population, the TIC (Testing, Inspection, Certification) partner ecosystem, and the AGS (Amazon Global Selling) team.
Key job responsibilities
Own the product roadmap for compliance capabilities serving China-origin sellers expanding to global Amazon marketplaces
Partner with local TIC providers (SGS, TÜV, Intertek, Bureau Veritas, domestic Chinese labs) to build integrated testing workflows that reduce seller compliance cost and time
Define requirements for the Forge pilot: consolidated test plans, lab connections, and pre-listing compliance guidance delivered through Seller Assistant
Represent the China seller voice in global compliance product decisions, translating on-the-ground seller friction into product requirements for Seattle-based engineering teams
Work with AGS, Cross-Border, and Global Store teams to identify compliance barriers preventing seller expansion and quantify the GMS opportunity behind each
Drive seller research through direct engagement with manufacturers in Shenzhen, Guangzhou, and Yiwu to validate product assumptions and test prototypes
Own metrics for China seller compliance experience: time to compliance, testing cost reduction, first-time approval rate, and cross-marketplace launch rate
Coordinate with regulatory bodies and industry groups on emerging requirements (EU Digital Product Passport, GPSR, battery regulations) that disproportionately affect China-origin sellers
A day in the life
You start the morning reviewing seller feedback from the latest Forge pilot cohort in Toys, identifying patterns in where sellers get stuck during the consolidated testing flow. By mid-morning you are meeting with a Shenzhen-based TIC partner to negotiate pre-negotiated pricing tiers for the next product category expansion. After lunch you join a weekly sync with the Seattle engineering team to review sprint progress on the Seller Assistant compliance integration, translating seller context from your field visits into prioritized requirements. Late afternoon you draft a product brief for the next China Seller Conference demo, working backwards from a seller who manufactures LED lighting and wants to sell in 9 marketplaces simultaneously. You close the day reviewing cross-border compliance data to identify which requirement gaps are blocking the most GMS for China sellers expanding to EU.
About the team
Amazon Compliance Safety Services (CoSS) builds the systems and experiences that help sellers meet compliance requirements across every Amazon marketplace. Our mission is to make compliance something Amazon handles on behalf of sellers, not something sellers navigate alone. The One Compliance program is unifying the seller compliance experience across product safety, restricted products, cross-border trade, and regulatory filings into a single journey. We are building toward a world where a seller tests once and sells globally from day one. The Shenzhen role is critical because China-origin sellers represent the largest cross-border seller population on Amazon and face the most complex multi-jurisdiction compliance requirements.

Amazon.com reaches customers around the globe on all seven continents, and are in need of individuals who want to help ensure a fast cost effective solution to delivering packages to every far reach of the world. Amazon-10606797.title: Sr. Seller Success Manager, Target Recruiting, Targeted Seller Recruitment
Amazon-10606797.description:
Sr. Seller Success Manager, Target Recruiting
About the team: Amazon Global Selling (AGS) works to bring a wide range of global selection to Amazon's worldwide stores. It does this by recruiting and supporting quality, compliant sellers from around the world. Within AGS, CN Global Selling (CNGS) helps millions of China-based sellers succeed on up to 17 Amazon marketplaces, including the US, Canada, Europe, Japan, Australia and India.
About the role:
As Sr. Seller Success Manager, Target Recruiting (TR), you will set the strategy for TR channels and manage them centrally where needed. Your goal is to help frontline sales get more sellers through the funnel and lower acquisition cost across the full channel portfolio, incl.
1. Set TR channel strategy. Use seller acquisition data and funnel performance to define the strategy and role of each channel: TR Events, PE/VC, Associations, SSP, Internal Referral and Seller Referral.
2. Build senior-level channel partnerships. Build and maintain relationships between senior leaders at Amazon and at TR channel partners, and turn them into leads and support for frontline sales.
3. Optimize the channel mix. Track how each channel performs, and move resources and budget toward the channels that turn the most leads into launched sellers at the best cost.
4. Work across teams. Partner with the China Account Management team, PMO, marketplace teams and global central functions to deliver results together.
What success looks like
1. You do well in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.
2. You bring strong analytical, program management and communication skills, plus a deep focus on customers.
3. You come up with new ideas and execute them reliably.
Join us If you want a fast-paced, innovative environment where you take on hard problems, make history and have fun along the way, we'd love to hear from you.
Key job responsibilities
Your responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
1. Strategy and execution
Own the strategy and execution plan for new seller recruiting and seller success within the New Seller Recruitment organization.
Work with Marketing, Tech, central PM, global product and marketplace teams to improve the seller experience and drive growth.
2. Goal setting and monitoring
Track how smoothly and quickly sellers move from registration to onboarding.
Set shared goals with global and local PMO teams to improve the experience and increase throughput.
3. Operational processes and mechanisms
Build and monitor the processes and mechanisms behind global selling, new seller recruitment and seller success.
Partner with the China Operations team on processes that help the Account Management team work more efficiently and follow process more consistently.
Influence the Central Global team to change things that improve operational efficiency and how resources are allocated.
Turn global initiatives into local operating processes.

Amazon-10588554.title: Sr. Solutions Architect, Fire TV Devices Business Development Team
Amazon-10588554.description:
The vision of the Fire TV organization is to create devices that allow our customers to experience the streamed content, games and apps that they most enjoy from all the range of TVs, brands they like across the world. Fire TV has focused on finding and engaging with the user's content and presenting it on the 'best screen in the house'.
As our device-maker partners grow their global footprint, we are looking for a Solutions Architect who can be the technical bridge between Amazon product and engineering teams and external partners, including original equipment manufacturers (OEMs), original design manufacturers (ODMs), system-on-chip (SoC) vendors, and component suppliers.
In this role you will combine technical knowledge of device hardware/software, Cloud Services, and AI/Voice services with the business acumen to engage partner leadership at the CTO level. You will guide partners through the full product lifecycle, from reference architecture selection and hardware bring-up to software integration and global launch. If you are a curious, collaborative problem-solver who thrives where technology meets business development, we would love to hear from you.
Key job responsibilities
- Act as the trusted technical advisor to partner CTO-level executives, translating their business goals into technology strategies that accelerate time-to-launch for devices shipping globally.
- Advise partners across the full Fire TV stack — device hardware/software, cloud and streaming services, and Alexa voice integration — helping them adopt new capabilities and deliver innovative customer experiences.
- Collaborate with internal product, engineering, and UX teams to represent partner and end-customer needs, shaping product specifications and roadmap priorities.
- Lead technical reviews of Fire TV device specifications and capabilities to share best practices and resolve integration challenges.
- Build scalable self-service tooling and reusable reference artifacts that help partners onboard and integrate more efficiently.
A day in the life
Your morning might start with a video call alongside an OEM engineering team working through a hardware bring-up issue on a new SoC platform, followed by a design review with the Fire TV software team to align on an upcoming integration milestone. After lunch you could be drafting a technical best-practices guide for partner onboarding, then joining a business development call to advise on the feasibility of a new device concept. You will regularly travel to meet partners and teammates around the world, building the relationships that turn ideas into products customers love.
About the team
The Fire TV Devices Business Development and Solutions Architecture team partners with TV manufacturers and SoC vendors worldwide to bring Fire TV-powered smart TVs to customers globally. Our team is distributed across multiple regions, and we work where hardware, software, and business strategy meet. We are investing in AI-powered tooling and self-service platforms to help partners integrate faster while maintaining the high-quality customer experience Fire TV is known for. If you want to shape how millions of people interact with their television, this is the team to join.
Amazon-10588554.requirements:
Basic qualifications
- 5+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
- Experience with one or more of: embedded systems / consumer devices, cloud-based or streaming media services, or voice/AI-driven experiences — including how they integrate into an end-to-end product
- Experience working directly with external partners (OEM/ODM, content/streaming, or platform partners) in a technical advisory, integration, or solutions role
- Speak, write, and read fluently in Mandarin and English

Preferred qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent
- Experience spanning more than one layer of the stack — e.g., device + cloud, streaming service + client integration, or voice/AI services integrated into a consumer product
- Experience working cross-functionally with business development, product, and partner engineering teams to land technical deals
- Familiarity with the TV / smart display / streaming devices (silicon vendors, panel makers, ODMs, content/streaming providers)

Amazon-10473963.title: Sr. Technical Account Manager, CMHK Enterprise Support
Amazon-10473963.description:
AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.
We are looking for technology thought-leaders who build long lasting and influential relationships at all levels of an organization.
Amazon has a history and tradition of leading the world in Web-related technologies and services. Now with Amazon Web Services (AWS) you have the chance to join the team as they help individuals and businesses take their computing infrastructures and applications into "the Cloud". As a member of the Amazon Web Services Enterprise Support team you will be at the forefront of Cloud technologies.
The Technical Account Manager (TAM) functions as part of the Enterprise Support team to ensure key enterprise customer success in building applications and services on the AWS platform. The TAM provides assistance to the customer as a strategic expert on the full line of AWS services and the customer's architecture in support of strategy questions, project and launch planning, and ongoing operational issues.
This role has a strong focus on GPU/AI infrastructure - supporting customers running large-scale distributed training and inference workloads on AWS accelerated compute instances. You will work with customers who operate many GPU instances helping them maximize training efficiency minimize disruption and plan capacity for rapid growth.
TAMs are engaged at the account level in providing recommendations and proactive advice through all phases of the cloud adoption life cycle. Every day will bring new and exciting challenges on the job while you:
* Champion and advocate for Enterprise Support customers * Be excited about cross-team and cross-org collaboration * Make recommendations on how new AWS offerings fit in the company strategy and architecture * Complete analysis and present periodic reviews of operational performance to customer * Provide deep reviews of service disruptions, metrics, and detailed prelaunch planning * Participate in customer requested meetings (onsite or remote) * Have access and know how to use all key customer resolution tools across all service groups to facilitate rapid resolution of customer concerns * Work with some of the leading technologists around the world * Work directly with Amazon Web Service engineers to ensure that customer issues are resolved as expediently as possible * Act as incident manager for complex or large impact incident
Key job responsibilities
• Support customers running large-scale AI/ML training workloads on accelerated compute instances providing architecture guidance and operational best practices
• Collaborate with AWS service teams to resolve complex infrastructure issues impacting customer workloads driving root cause analysis and proactive risk mitigation
• Advise on capacity planning performance optimization and infrastructure readiness for customers adopting next-generation compute
About the team
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud.
Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Amazon-10584185.title: Sr. Technical Program Manager
Amazon-10584185.description:
Amazon Devices builds custom silicon for edge AI products. Each SoC we ship it gets reused in new products, extended with new software features, and supported in production for years. We are looking for a Sr. Technical Program Manager to own that phase: drive SoC and software execution for new products built on existing Amazon silicon, and lead the program for silicon health from first production through end of life.
In this role you will also work backwards from launch KPIs for each new product intercept. You will plan and drive the SoC software work needed to bring new features to those products, and partner with production engineering as needed over the life of the chip.
You will also turn what each program teaches us into reusable playbooks and share best practices across the TPM community.
Key job responsibilities
* Drive SoC and software readiness for new products adopting an existing Amazon SoC, from requirements and gap analysis through xVT and launch.
* Work with product-line device software and device OS teams to scope, plan, and deliver new SoC software features (drivers, firmware, BSP, ML runtime enablement, power/performance tuning) without destabilizing products already in market.
* Define hand-off criteria, milestone metrics, and tracking tools within PDP for intercept programs. Contribute to risk trade-offs and milestone acceptance decisions.
* Support product teams with silicon characterization, hardware, and validation data for xVT integration.

Amazon-10486931.description:
Amazon.com strives to be Earth's most customer-centric company where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy online. By giving customers more of what they want - low prices, vast selection, and convenience - Amazon.com continues to grow and evolve as a world-class e-commerce platform. Amazon's evolution from Web site to e-commerce partner to development platform is driven by the spirit of innovation that is part of the company's DNA. The world's brightest technology minds come to Amazon.com to research and develop technology that improves the lives of shoppers and sellers around the world.

Vendor Consultant Program in Amazon RBS organization is to own operational business metrics and associated tasks for JP AVS vendors. In this role, you will leverage your deep expertise in Marketing Operations to design scalable operational solutions that improve vendor business performance. You will own end-to-end workflows across marketing-related operational activities, driving key business metrics. You will work closely with Vendor Consultants, JP Retail team, global partner teams, and technology team to standardize processes, eliminate operational defects, and build automation solutions that improve both operational efficiency and vendor outcomes.
This role requires strong analytical thinking, program management, stakeholder management, and continuous improvement capabilities.

-Own the Marketing Operations service pillar by driving improvements across key business metrics, including Retail GV, Ads Spend, and Deals Operations.
-Design and optimize scalable end-to-end workflows to improve operational efficiency, service quality, and vendor outcomes.
-Lead cross-functional initiatives with Product Families, Vendor Consultants, and global stakeholders to deliver operational excellence.
-Analyze business performance, identify root causes, and implement data-driven solutions through process optimization and automation.
-Serve as the Marketing Operations subject matter expert by establishing best practices, standardizing operations, and providing functional guidance across the organization.
About the team
The RBS VCP program supports AVS Signature vendor growth by owning and improving input KPIs (VGP) across Availability, IDQ and Marketing Ops metrics. By transferring ownership of such metrics and associated operational tasks to RBS VCs, we eliminate the operational burden on Brand Specialists, thereby improving AVS productivity.

Amazon-10371249.description:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking a Deal Lead for the Strategic Customer Engagements (SCE) team.
SCE is a specialized global deal team that engages with commercial and public sector customers on deal strategy, structuring, and negotiations through contractual closure for transformational, strategic, large, complex, and/or highly competitive opportunities such as GenAI. This is a unique opportunity to engage with AWS customers on strategic opportunities, increase the growth of AWS (Americas/EMEA/APJ), and to establish AWS as their key cloud technology provider. These opportunities range across industry verticals, such as Financial Services, Telecommunications, Media & Entertainment, Energy, Healthcare Life Sciences, Automotive and Manufacturing, and Public Sector, and customer size (from start-ups to enterprise customers). These engagements may also involve Pan-Amazon and AWS go-to-market opportunities involving close partnership between the SCE team and other Amazon and AWS stakeholders.
As a SCE Deal Lead, you will be responsible for managing the end to end Deal Cycle for strategic, large, complex or highly competitive deals. You will focus on earning trust with customers by creating actionable strategies, developing and shaping opportunities, and leading deal engagements through negotiations and closure. This highly visible role will own engagement with customer C-level executives, IT teams, and multiple lines of business to achieve business outcomes, increase the adoption of AWS services, and to enable private pricing, go-to-market, pan-Amazon, and other strategic relationships. You will work collaboratively to drive results by partnering with AWS customers, AWS field sales executives, and other internal stakeholders to empower our customers to evolve, address challenges, and to create innovative solutions.

- Lead negotiations and customer closure for strategic, large, complex or highly competitive deals
- Develop and shape the overall deal strategy and structure to meet customer business outcome and goals
- Contribute to developing AWS’s value proposition and solutions
- Drive revenue growth and Cloud adoption
- Closely collaborate with key stakeholders across the organization for (Americas/EMEA/APJ) regional sales teams, and related regional and global stakeholders (Service Teams, Finance, Legal, etc.)
- Act as a trusted advisor in the development of the commercial strategy of deals with AWS Field Sales Executives: partner in the execution of the sales cycle for strategic, complex, or highly competitive commercial opportunities
- Inspire, influence, and facilitate alignment with internal stakeholders, experts, and other resources not under direct control, to remove obstacles and achieve desired business outcomes
- Develop strategies for pricing and discounts; effectively communicate and identify deal blockers
- Lead or support presentation of deal proposals to Customers
About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Amazon-10561328.title: Supply Chain Manager, Amazon SEND
Amazon-10561328.description:
We are seeking a Supply Chain Manager to help scale Amazon SEND, a cross-border logistics solution for FBA sellers worldwide. In this role, you will work backwards from customer problems and partner closely with carriers to elevate the seller experience on Amazon SEND.
You will sit at the core of supply chain innovation, where your ability to drive alignment across internal and external teams directly shapes both seller and carrier outcomes.
You will identify opportunities, lead process improvements, and strengthen the value proposition of Amazon SEND. Success in this role demands expertise in cross-border logistics, strong stakeholder management, and a proven ability to drive progress across diverse teams. If you are a collaborative, data-driven problem solver who wants to deliver impact at scale, we want to hear from you.
Key job responsibilities
- Develop and track performance metrics that measure business results, using data analysis to surface trends and recommend supply chain improvements for cross-border logistics.
- Collaborate with external partners — including carriers and vendors — to negotiate solutions, close deals, and grow shipping volume across international lanes.
- Work with internal teams such as Operations, Procurement, Fulfillment Centers, Seller Support, and Product and Tech to align on priorities and remove roadblocks.
- Monitor cross-border logistics market trends and proactively flag opportunities or risks that affect customer experience and business continuity.
- Build trusted relationships with local and global stakeholders, document findings for leadership, and create process improvements that support the team's goals.
A day in the life
You will start your morning reviewing business metrics and carrier performance dashboards, then jump into calls with partnered carriers to discuss volume targets or resolve operational issues. Midday might find you working with Procurement on a new proposal or pulling together a market trend analysis for your manager. In the afternoon, you will document your findings, update stakeholder reports, and collaborate with teammates to refine outreach strategies — all while picking up best practices and sharpening your analytical skills.
About the team
Amazon SEND is a cross-border logistics solution integrated into Seller Central that enables FBA sellers to ship inventory from their home country to Amazon fulfillment centers in destination countries. The team's mission is to make cross-border shipping easy, reliable, and competitively priced for selling partners located anywhere in the world. We are in an exciting growth phase, actively scaling volume and expanding into new lanes. As part of this team, you will work closely with partnered carriers and collaborate across Amazon to help shape the future of global seller logistics.

Amazon-10486595.title: Support Ops Manager II, FBA Support Operations
Amazon-10486595.description:
WW Selling Partner Services (SPS) is focused on making Amazon the safest and most trusted company on earth for customers, brands, and selling partners and the best place to build a successful business. Within SPS, Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) is a service selling partners engage to make their items available to customers around the world who take advantage of Amazon Prime. FBA Support Operations is a critical bridge between Amazon’s product, technology, and fulfillment network teams and our selling partners. We currently serve the US, CA, EU, JP, AU, MX, and BR marketplaces, but our vision is to build a global team that follows the sun. Our work spans over 70 workstreams – from individualized coaching of selling partners, to resolving cases when something goes wrong in the inbound shipping and fulfillment processes, to identifying and correcting defects in selling partner shipments that can add cost and risk safety and customer experience.
We are looking for a results-oriented, customer-obsessed, data-driven leader who is passionate about innovating and optimizing across people, processes and technology to be a world-class support organization. The ideal candidate is an influential leader with a proven track record inspiring their team to deliver big results. They are able to continuously improve the operational efficiency of their team through good prioritization, and communication skills, as well as the ability to navigate ambiguity. They have the capability and passion to foster a culture of innovation, inspiring their team to identify process and technology improvements that complement operational excellence to deliver increasingly better outcomes. They will index high on people development, and they believe at their core that leaders operate at all levels of an organization. The ideal candidate also demonstrates strong seller-facing communication leadership — they understand how to build trust-based advisory relationships with selling partners, coach their team to move beyond transactional interactions, and drive meaningful seller engagement that results in sustained behavioral change and defect elimination.
Operations: The candidate needs to be able to drive results in a production environment. Must lead their team and stakeholders towards meeting operational metrics of quality, productivity, and service levels. Will be responsible for setting the goals and vision for the function(s) operating under the candidate. This includes owning the end-to-end seller coaching lifecycle, ensuring the team delivers measurable account-level impact rather than transactional case resolution.
Stakeholder Management and Communication: The candidate would need to interact with multiple stakeholders within India and globally and at times, would be required to influence and drive consensus between teams. The candidate would also be required to write high impact, clear and concise documents (Support Strategies, Business review documents, etc.). Additionally, the candidate must be able to represent the seller coaching program's impact and insights to senior leadership, translating frontline seller engagement data into strategic narratives that inform program direction and investment decisions.
People Leadership: The candidate would be responsible for creating mechanisms for employee growth and development. This would mean enabling People Managers and creating succession plans. Will strike the right balance between effective delegation while maintain a connect with the team through different communication channels (1:1 connects, Huddles, Open office hours etc.). The candidate must develop their team's consultative communication skills — coaching specialists to adaptive insight-driven seller advisory dialogues that uncover root causes and build long-term seller trust.
Process Improvements, Automation, and Innovation: The candidate would need to drive innovation within the team, such that operational inefficiencies can be removed and existing procedures/SOPs be enhanced. Should be able to identify and lead projects across various teams, develop new metrics and drive creation of new tools for the same. The candidate should leverage seller engagement insights and frontline feedback to identify systemic defect patterns, propose scalable coaching interventions, and partner with DP&R and product teams to translate seller-facing observations into program-level improvements.
We value individual expression, respect different opinions, and work together to create a culture where each of us is able to contribute fully. Our unique backgrounds and perspectives strengthen our ability to achieve Amazon’s mission of being Earth’s most customer-centric company.
Key job responsibilities
•	Responsible for the overall direction and performance of 15–20 Seller Outreach Specialists.
•	Set the vision, direction, and culture of the team by managing individual and team performance expectations and goals.
•	Manage the career growth and development of their associates by driving focus on Amazon's Core Values. Play a critical role in building management depth by providing guidance and mentorship to all levels of leadership within their organizational units, as well as serving as a role model.
•	Effectively partner and build productive working relationships with direct reports, peers, leadership, and other departments to solve medium to high complexity problems.
•	Drive seller engagement quality by establishing coaching standards, reviewing seller interactions, and ensuring the team builds trust-based advisory relationships rather than transactional touchpoints.
•	Serve as a leader and point of contact for escalated contact resolution of a supervisory or sensitive nature.
•	Provide analysis and program support to stakeholder teams. Surface actionable insights from seller engagement patterns to inform program strategy, identify systemic root causes, and recommend scalable interventions.
•	Identify and eliminate root cause barriers to accuracy, productivity, quality, and seller knowledge gaps. Facilitate regular portfolio reviews and insight-sharing sessions to promote cross-team learning and ensure consistent coaching quality across the portfolio.
•	Deep dive trend data related to customer contacts and defect prevention. Leverage account-level data to identify coaching opportunities, track before/after performance deltas, and drive data-informed decisions on seller prioritization and intervention timing.
•	Lead team meetings focused on team performance, policy and site updates, and team-building activities.

AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.
Would you like to join one of the fastest-growing teams within Amazon Web Services (AWS)? Join us in helping customers across all industries to maximize the value and benefits of AWS services and Generative AI solutions.
As a Technical Account Manager (TAM) in AWS Enterprise Support you will play a crucial role in fostering our customers' innovative and transformative endeavors across various technologies including Generative AI/ML, Compute, Storage, Database, Big Data, Application-level Services, Networking, Serverless, Deployment, Security, and more. This is not a sales role - it offers you the opportunity to serve as the primary technical advisor and 'voice of the customer' for organizations ranging from start-ups to Fortune 500 enterprises.
Based in Shenzhen, you will work with a diverse portfolio of local and regional enterprise customers across industries including Financial Services, Gaming, Media & Entertainment, E-commerce, and Technology. You will be part of the CMHK Enterprise Support team, collaborating closely with Solution Architects, Account Managers, and Partner teams to deliver exceptional customer outcomes.
This is an exciting time to join - our customers are rapidly adopting Generative AI and AI/ML services on AWS, from Amazon Bedrock and SageMaker to custom model training on GPU infrastructure. As a TAM you will be at the forefront of helping customers navigate this transformation guiding them on architecture operational readiness and best practices for AI workloads in production. You will also leverage AI-powered tools in your own workflow to deliver faster more proactive support.
Key job responsibilities
• Act as a single point of contact for Enterprise Support customers building trusted advisor relationships
• Provide strategic technical guidance across the full cloud adoption lifecycle - from migration planning to operational optimization
• Make recommendations on how new AWS offerings (including Generative AI/ML) fit into customer strategy and architecture
• Complete analysis and present periodic reviews of operational performance to customers
• Provide detailed reviews of service disruptions metrics and prelaunch planning
• Champion and advocate for customer requirements within AWS (e.g., feature requests, service improvements)
• Participate in customer meetings (onsite or remote) and maintain regular engagement cadence
• Leverage customer resolution tools across all service groups to facilitate rapid resolution of customer concerns
• Work directly with AWS service engineers to ensure customer issues are resolved expediently
• Collaborate with internal teams including DSE, SBAS, and account teams to deliver holistic support
• Available for non-business hours support to handle urgent issues and critical events
About the team
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud.
Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Amazon-10587289.title: Transportation Specialist - Transportation, NOC Outbound
Amazon-10587289.description:
NOC (Network Operations Center) is the central command and control center for ‘Transportation Execution’ across the Amazon Supply Chain network supporting multiple geographies like NA, India and EU. It ensures hassle free, timely pick-up and delivery of freight from vendors to Amazon fulfillment centers (FC) and from Amazon FCs to carrier hubs. In case of any exceptions, NOC steps in to resolve the issue and keeps all the stakeholders informed on the proceedings. Along with this tactical problem solving NOC is also charged with understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline operations. This second aspect involves network monitoring and significant analysis of network data.
Overall, NOC plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon transportation and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon’s ability to serve its customers on time.
Purview of a Trans Ops Specialist
A Trans Ops Specialist at NOC facilitates flow of information between different stakeholders (Trans Carriers/Hubs/Warehouses) and resolves any potential issues that impacts customer experience and business continuity. This role is a part of the centralized Network Operations Centre (NOC) org part of Amazon India. This role is based in Dalian, China and will be required to work for Amazon Japan.
Key job responsibilities
· Communication with external customers (Carriers, Vendors/Suppliers) and internal customers (Retail, Finance, Software Support, Fulfillment Centers)
· Ability to pull data from numerous databases (using Excel, Access, SQL and/or other data management systems) and to perform ad hoc reporting and analysis as needed is a plus.
· Develop and/or understand performance metrics to assist with driving business results.
· Ability to scope out business and functional requirements for the Amazon technology teams who create and enhance the software systems and tools are used by NOC.
· Must be able to quickly understand the business impact of the trends and make decisions that make sense based on available data.
· Must be able to systematically escalate problems or variance in the information and data to the relevant owners and teams and follow through on the resolutions to ensure they are delivered.
· Work within various time constraints to meet critical business needs, while measuring and identifying activities performed.
· Excellent communication, both verbal and written as one may be required to create a narrative outlining weekly findings and the variances to goals, and present these finding in a review forum. Languages proficiency (mandatory) – Japanese.
Providing real-time customer experience by working in 24*7 operating environment (INCLUDING NIGHT SHIFT)
